subject: Social Media
title: Tim Wu and the Merchants
description: A quick win: understand Tim Wu and the Merchants.

hook.text: Tim Wu wrote 'The Attention Merchants' tracing how industries learned to harvest human focus for profit.

buildup.text: It started with newspapers in the 1830s. Benjamin Day sold the New York Sun for one penny. Ads paid the rest.

discovery.text: Radio, TV, and the internet each repeated the pattern: offer free content, sell the audience's attention.

twist.text: Wu showed each medium promised liberation but delivered manipulation. Social media is just the latest cycle.

climax.text: The pattern repeats because it works. Attention capture is the most profitable business model ever invented.

punchline.text: Every free medium has a hidden price: your gaze.

quiz.question: According to Tim Wu, what pattern repeats across media history?
